states.title: Start
states.description: You wake up in a dark room. There's not quite anything to do at the moment, so you might as well explore.

states.title: Sat Down
states.description: You sit down, expecting to feel the cold floor beneath your feet. But instead, you find yourself in another dark room. There's not quite anything to do at the moment, so you might as well explore.

states.title: Defeat
states.description: Suddenly, an unknown force strikes you, and you feel a cold breeze.

states.title: Looking Around?
states.description: You look around, hoping to spot something you could use. Suddenly, an unknown force strikes you, and you feel a cold breeze. It seems familiar but also seems to make you feel sleepy. Very sleepy, in fact.

states.title: Explored 1
states.description: You make your best effort to explore, but can't find much due to the darkness. However, you do see a small stone on the ground.

options.action: Look around to see if there are more objects
Sit down and think about what to do next / how to use it

states.title: Has Stone
states.description: You pick up the stone. It feels smooth and light. The strange thing is, it somehow feels cold to the touch, yet also seems to heat you up. You shrug and put it in your pocket. Maybe you can figure out what it does later / find a way to use it?

options.action: Look around to see if there are more objects
Sit down and think about what to do next / how to use it

states.title: Explored 2
states.description: You make your best effort to explore, but can't find much due to the darkness. However, you do notice a hard metallic surface. As you feel around, you notice what appears to be a handle.

options.action: Look around to see if there are more objects
Sit down and think about what to do next
Go back and check the stone you ignored
Try to open the metallic door
